title: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.39278v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. translated_title: WorldFlow：通过大规模预训练实现视频与3D运动的联合预测
translated_abstract: 预测未来的物理状态是具身智能中的一个核心挑战。现有的视频世界模型将3D动力学隐式化，基于动作的公式化仍然绑定于特定的机器人配置，而3D运动预测模型仅使用光流监督，为物理动力学提供的学习信号十分有限。为了规避这些限制，我们提出了WorldFlow，一种能够联合预测未来视频和基于查询的3D轨迹的生成式世界模型。通过将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移标记，一个统一的混合Transformer（Mixture-of-Transformers, MoT）骨干网络在整流流（rectified-flow）目标下对两种模态进行联合去噪。这种公式化将显式的几何动力学与视觉演化耦合在一起，有效地释放了预训练视频模型中蕴含的物理常识。为了在实证上扩展并验证这一统一架构，我们在异构（摘要在此处截断）……上训练WorldFlow。
tldr: WorldFlow是一种生成式世界模型，它将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移标记，并利用统一的Mixture-of-Transformers骨干网络在整流流目标下联合去噪视频与3D两种模态，从而将显式几何动力学与视觉演化耦合，释放预训练视频模型中蕴含的物理常识。
en_tdlr: WorldFlow is a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories by parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, enabling a unified Mixture-of-Transformers backbone to jointly denoise both modalities under a rectified-flow objective, thereby coupling explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution to unlock the physical commonsense embedded in pretrained video models.
